exact_statement: For every nonconstant monotone sign Boolean g on s>=1 uniform bits and any finite positive CNF G=(1+g)/2=AND_j C_j(z) with t>=1 nonempty core clauses, form F_L=2 AND_(j,l<=L)(C_j(z) OR y_jl)-1 using distinct fresh positive private bits, L>=1. Every displayed clause is an irredundant prime implicate and every private bit is relevant. With b(z)=number of false anchors, epsilon=2^-L, a(z)=epsilon^b(z), q=Pr[g=-1], the EXACT physical identities are I_private=2L E[b epsilon^b], I_core=sum_i E|a(z)-a(z xor e_i)| and private spectral mass M=4E[a(1-a)]. They imply |I(F_L)-I(g)|<=2q(s+L)epsilon and M<=4qepsilon. Thus H(F_L)->H(g), I(F_L)->I(g)>0 and H(F_L)/I(F_L)->H(g)/I(g) for each fixed g and fixed CNF. The supremum H/I on this positive-core positive-private CNF class equals that on ALL monotone Boolean functions. For L>=3 an explicit entropy error is |H(F_L)-H(g)|<=h2(4epsilon)+4epsilon s+4qepsilon(s+tL). This is monotone-FEI universality only, not equivalence with full Boolean FEI. Unlike signed-point anchors, nonempty core amplitudes need not share a common scaling: AND2 gives ratios 1-epsilon^2 and (1-epsilon)^2. No universal paid source, common-scaling finite reference extraction, uncharged wrapper or history reset is asserted.
